newsitem.title: USA: MERRILL LYNCH HIRES NEW CORPORATE BOND STRATEGIST.
newsitem.headline: MERRILL LYNCH HIRES NEW CORPORATE BOND STRATEGIST.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc officials said the firm has hired William Cunningham as its new senior investment-grade corporate bond strategist.
He will be taking over for Leland Crabbe who has moved to the new-issue syndicate desk at Merrill Lynch.
In his new position, Cunningham will report to Thomas Sowanick, director of fixed-income strategy at Merrill.
The post will involve developing strategies for all investments in dollar-denominated high-grade corporate bonds, including both domestic and Yankee issues, Cunningham said.
Cunningham said he previously worked at Neuberger & Berman LLC, where he served as a senior portfolio manager and managed $3 billion in fixed-income assets.
Calls to Neuberger & Berman were not returned.
